worker.command:
set -eu
ulimit -c 0
mkdir -p /tmp/bootstrap
printf %s  | base64 -d > /tmp/bootstrap/setup.sh
bash <<'BASH'
set -e
source /tmp/bootstrap/setup.sh
cd "$SRC"
unset SGLANG_PLATFORM
export SGLANG_USE_CPU_ENGINE=1 PYTHONPATH="$SRC:$SRC/python"
python test/registered/unit/hardware_backend/tpu/test_glm52_channelwise_fp8.py
echo GLM52_PEER_RUNTIME_CPU_PASS
BASH
